description: This Java class implements a timer that records elapsed time using the Kamon monitoring library and is part of a metrics collection framework within a service. It provides timing functionality, tag management, and lifecycle handling for timers based on Kamon.

classes.name: StoppedKamonTimer
classes.description: A Kamon-based implementation of a stopwatch timer that records duration and tags, and interacts with Kamon metrics.

methods.name: fromStartedTimer
methods.description: Creates an instance of StoppedKamonTimer from a StartedTimer object, stopping the timer and capturing metrics.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Returns the total elapsed time as a Duration object.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Returns a copy of the timer's tags.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the value of a specific tag by key, or null if not present.

methods.name: getKamonInternalTimer
methods.description: Returns the associated Kamon timer object with the current tags.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the timer.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the timer object for debugging.

methods.name: getElapsedNano
methods.description: Calculates and returns the elapsed time in nanoseconds.
